comment: detect.c trapped_chest_at() steed arm (166-169). As in trap-detect-steed-carries-trapped-box, a debug Knight's pony picks up a wished trapped large box on trap-free Dlvl 1 of seed 9133002. This time he wishes a squeaky board where he stands before forcing the mount, so after a cursed potion of confusion the uncursed scroll of gold detection shows the trap map (the board is away from him). The steed's box puts the trapped-chest symbol on his own spot, so display_trap_map() leaves TER_MON out, and autodescribe at his spot reaches trap_description() -> trapped_chest_at(), which finds no box on the floor or in his inventory and finds it in the steed's inventory.
